answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 30260 Country: India Title: May kindly let me know the meanings of word zunairah is it all good to name my girl child zunerah.kindly let me know its correct spelling. Question: May kindly let me know the meanings of word zunairah is it all good to name my girl child zunerah.kindly let me know its correct spelling. Answer ID: 30260 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 517/313/D=1432) The correct word is Zinnira (زِنَّيْرَه) which means: small pebble. It was the name of a handmaid Sahabiyah. Hadhrat Abu Bakar Siddiq (رضى الله عنه) bought her and set her free. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
